description: Apart from AI surveillance, the state government is increasing the height of prison boundary walls and installing modern security equipment to improve overall safety
body_lead: Apart from AI surveillance, the state government is increasing the height of prison boundary walls and installing modern security equipment to improve overall safety Bhubaneswar: The Odisha government has decided to strengthen prison security by expanding the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI)-based surveillance systems across jails to prevent inmate escapes, detect violent incidents, and curb alleged collusion between prison staff and criminals.
